hardware: M2 Max MacBook Pro, built-in 120 Hz display
method: Release binaries; native fullscreen 1728x1084 points, 2x, 12 pt, continuous mode unchanged; screen unlocked and window frontmost. No input injection during procedural scenarios. Source experiments and final repeats retained separately. No general smoothness or CPU improvement claim.
percentileNote: Build26 tab/highlight summaries did not emit p99; with 18/24/60 samples the current floor(n*p) convention yields the maximum at p99. No invented raw latency samples.
setupNote: Baseline setup captures hidden editor grid 201x64; final 201x62 reflects the retained 30pt toolbar preventing shell/editor roundtrip resizes. Visible editing geometry is the intended invariant. Shell grid unchanged. Launch phase values are not startup comparison evidence.

diagnosticTrace.scope: Intermediate retained-width cache experiment, not final release A/B. Per-generation stage timings identify scheduling, row preparation and presentation waits.

rejectedExperiments.reason: Separate prefetch workers increased strip churn and worst resize stalls; rejected.
Width-independent terminal row cache passed pixels but worsened maximum resize stalls; rejected.
Conservative renderer before final tab-label and nonblocking service-error fixes; diagnostic, not final.

verification.editorRuntime: pass, including Python diagnostics/definition and private-PTY service-error/duplicate-name regression
verification.packaging: resources and strict ad-hoc signature verified; no notarization claim
verification.realUI: Installed final app: both same-basename TypeScript fixtures opened; screenshot showed correct two/one text and parent labels; rapid file/shell switching settled on one. Missing TypeScript SDK notice remained dismissible and did not block navigation. Long explorer filenames, small/large/reversed driver scrolls, refresh and sidebar resizing exercised. Twelve-tab overflow revealed the first tab at the left edge and retained a visible tab position; temporary terminals/fixtures closed without edits.
verification.realInputLimits: External UI-driver actions establish correctness, not natural trackpad feel, hardware event-to-photon latency, momentum-phase coverage or pixel identity at each physical refresh. Hover visual cost is procedural. Final manual trace could not be correlated to those UI actions, so it is excluded from latency evidence. Native anchor/overflow/pixel tests cover additional invariants. No authenticated SSH/SFTP or macOS13 device check.
verification.remaining: Resize stalls, held motion frames and correct-buffer presentation delay remain. No uninterrupted 120fps or parity claim.
